title: DevX daily fixlog - tutorial & docs triage
body:
Daily fixlog (brain-dump + micro plan) - Lila

Date: 2026-03-13
Context: quick focused triage of SDK docs, two broken tutorial flows, and a tiny sample app we promised in the onboarding checklist. Keep this personal and ephemeral.

Top priorities (today)
- P0: Fix tutorial 'Create a chat bot' broken code sample (authors: me + Evelyn). Repro steps below. ETA 2-3h.
- P1: Draft mini sample app: 'sync embeddings to vector DB' (node + python snippets). Make it copy-paste friendly. ETA 3-4h (can split across two days).
- P2: Quick doc gap list for SDK reference pages: streaming, function-calling examples, error handling. Add to product backlog. ETA 1h to capture.

Blocking / known issues
- Chat tutorial: streaming example uses old client.stream() API (no longer exported). Failure mode: sample throws "client.stream is not a function" on Node v18. Patch candidates: update to client.responses.stream or show fetch-based streaming example.
- Sample app readme references S3 bucket that doesn't exist. Need to replace with local fixtures and instructions for ephemeral buckets.

Repro notes - failing tutorial (steps I ran)
1) npx create-redwood-chat && cd create-redwood-chat
2) npm i @redwoodai/sdk@0.9.2
3) node examples/chat-stream.js -> immediate crash: client.stream is not a function
4) Workaround: replace streaming snippet with responses.streamFrom(asyncIterator) or simple poll/long-poll approach.

Patch plan for tutorial
- Sprint small PR: 1) update package example to pinned SDK stable import (example uses @redwoodai/sdk -> should be @redwood-inference/sdk). 2) replace streaming snippet with long-poll + streaming note OR show fetch+server-sent-events pattern. 3) add test script that runs node examples/chat-stream.js in CI step (fast smoke).
- PR checklist: update code block, update package.json example, add one-line test in examples/.github/workflows/ci-examples.yml.

Sample app: embeddings -> vector DB
- Goal: 6-file minimal app (README.md, package.json, index.js, ingest.js, query.js, .env.example).
- Requirements: show both node and python snippet for open-source vector DB (we'll use milvus-lite / or plain sqlite store shim). Keep auth minimal: REDWOOD_API_KEY env var.
- Nice-to-have: tiny script to batch-embed a CSV and a query endpoint. Keep one-liners for terminal.

Doc gaps (short list to push to backlog)
- Streaming: missing canonical pattern for Node + browser + server-sent-events.
- Function calling: example where multiple tools are registered and orchestrated.
- Errors: mapping of SDK error codes to HTTP/JSON payloads.
- Versioning: clear guidance on pinning SDK vs using server-side compatibility policy.

Tiny TODOs (quick wins, ~10-20m each)
- [ ] Replace deprecated import in chat tutorial (code block only).
- [ ] Update README link to dedicated examples repo.
- [ ] Add note about required Node version (>=18.10) to all JS examples.
- [ ] Create Linear tasks for sample app UI and infra.

Notes-to-self
- Pair with Evelyn at 11:30 for 30m to review streaming options. Bring two alternatives: SSE vs poll+delta.
- Keep PR small; prefer clarity over fancy streaming code. Add comments in-line explaining tradeoffs.
- Save a copy of working example in examples/working/chat-stream-fixed.js before committing.

Local commands I ran today (history snippets)
- npm i @redwood-inference/sdk@latest --save-exact
- node --version -> v18.12.1
- env REDWOOD_KEY=x node examples/chat-stream-fixed.js

Next steps (tomorrow)
- Merge tutorial fix PR and trigger examples CI.
- Start writing embeddings sample app scaffold; sync with Marin on vector DB choice.
- Convert quick doc gap list into product-op ticket with severity and user-impact notes.

Random ideas (parking lot)
- Mini 'migration guide' for customers moving from old SDK -> new SDK (cheat-sheet of 10 common breaking changes).
- Interactive snippet runner on docs site that uses ephemeral tokens (sandbox) - risky but powerful.

End of scratchpad.

-- Lila
